messages.subject: Exiting locally running shiny session
parts:
I use emacs to run R. I start shiny the normal way... library(shiny); runApp("something"), but when I do a ctrl-C ctrl-C to stop the running function in R, I get this... 

Java requested System.exit(130), closing R.

Process R exited abnormally with code 130

So, I have to start R up again and whatnot. Is there any way to get this function to exit gracefully, so I don't have to restart R?

cn
